about: Examples of the command Repair-Loop copies for running the check from a terminal. terminal.js must produce each `copies` exactly (repair-loop-run.test.js); crates/cli/tests/repair_loop_terminal_command.rs runs each `copies`, with {change} replaced by a real Change id, through /bin/sh in a scratch repository holding src/upload/retry.rs, against a scratch store, and asserts it is recorded as a check run.
